prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: approval mockup/reference turnaround for a friendly blacksmith NPC in Stone & Shadow, a painted first-person grid dungeon game. Concept only, not production animation frames.
Input image: the supplied innkeeper turnaround is a STYLE AND SHEET FORMAT reference only. Create a new, distinctly different blacksmith character; retain the richly textured hand-painted fantasy game illustration, dimensional shading, clean readable silhouette, true cardinal full-body views and separate speaking portrait.
Primary request: one polished wide transparent character sheet showing the SAME very tall, exceptionally muscular adult HUMAN male blacksmith in four full-body standing views, followed by one larger front-facing head-and-shoulders conversational expression study.
Subject: human man around 40, long-legged tall human proportions, immense shoulders, thick neck, powerful chest and very muscular bare arms and forearms from years at the forge. A magnificent, very large, dense FULL copper-red beard and moustache, spreading across his upper chest; beautifully textured loose beard, naturally shaped rather than ornate. Bright natural red hair. Haircut inspired by the rugged hairstyles in the television show Vikings: closely shaved sides and back beneath a long central strip of red hair, swept back into a thick practical braid tied behind his head. Show the haircut clearly in side and back views. Original face, no actor likeness. Strong weathered face, ordinary human ears, attentive eyes, a calm confident expression and subtle friendly smile; imposing physique but approachable civilian craftsman.
Wardrobe: a dark charcoal sleeveless work shirt beneath a heavy dark brown leather bib apron, broad shoulder straps and a waist tie, worn/scorched leather with restrained soot marks; muscular upper arms fully visible. Dark practical trousers and heavy worn brown leather boots. Modest practical medieval work clothing, natural earthy colors that let the red beard and hair stand out. Empty bare hands, arms relaxed slightly away from sides. No gloves obscuring hands, no armor, no jewelry, no tattoos or decorative fantasy embellishments.
Composition: wide sheet, four evenly spaced full-body views ordered FRONT, PROFILE FACING SCREEN LEFT, BACK, PROFILE FACING SCREEN RIGHT, then a separate larger front-facing speaking bust on the far right. Exactly four full-body figures plus one bust total. True cardinal views, identical body scale and planted boot baseline, entire heads, braid, hands, apron and boots visible with generous transparent gaps and margins. Consistent body shape, hair, beard, face, apron straps and clothing in every view. Bust shows his lips slightly parted in natural conversation, a small welcoming smile, same large beard and haircut. Grounded neutral standing poses suitable as later references for subtle breathing/blinking idle and small mouth/head talk animation; no exaggerated gesturing.
Style and lighting: match the supplied innkeeper artwork's richly detailed painterly medieval game style, realistic adult anatomy with crisp non-pixelated edges, fine material texture and soft upper-left light. Human smith should read tall, strong and grounded, not a dwarf or a superhero.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background. No environment, floor, counter, anvil, hammer, weapons, tools in hands, drop shadow ellipse, checkerboard pattern, background gradient, decorative frame, text, labels, UI, logo or watermark. No walking, combat or forging action. Avoid short stocky dwarf proportions, oversized head, cartoon/anime simplification, glossy 3D and photography. This is a character approval sheet, not a game screenshot.
